rows.answer: Full-time employees receive **25 days** of paid time off per year, plus public holidays [1]. They are also encouraged to take at least one block of 10 consecutive working days off each year [1]. Employees with over five years of tenure may additionally work from anywhere for two weeks beyond their standard allowance [2], though this is distinct from the base PTO entitlement.

The per diem rate for travelers in Portugal is €55 per day [1]. On the first and last day of a trip, this amount is reduced to 75% of the daily rate. Meals provided by a conference or customer should not be claimed separately from this allowance.
The nightly hotel price cap in Europe is €180, excluding taxes [1]. In very expensive cities or during major trade shows, Navan may show a higher dynamic cap which is acceptable [1].
The office anchor days are Tuesday and Thursday [1][2]. Most team rituals, planning sessions, and lunch happen on these specific days unless a manager agrees otherwise [2].

The one-time home-office stipend is **$500** (or €460 in Portugal) [1]. This amount can be used to purchase a desk, chair, monitor, or similar items; laptops and core peripherals are provided by IT separately.
Laptops are replaced every 3 years, or earlier if they fail [1]. IT will contact employees about two months before this replacement date occurs [1].

Primary caregivers are entitled to **16 weeks** of fully paid parental leave [1][3]. This entitlement applies from the first day of employment for all permanent employees in Portugal and the United States, regardless of gender or how they become a parent [4]. The leave can be taken as one continuous block within the first 12 months after the child arrives [1].

You may accept gifts with a value of up to $75 per person per year from any single company [1]. Anything above that must be declined or reported to Legal, and cash or gift cards are never acceptable during active negotiations.
The address of the Lisbon office is Rua da Prata 112, 1100-417 Lisboa [1]. The entrance to floors 3 and 4 is next to the pastelaria.

The public list price for the Growth tier is $79 per seat per month [1]. This pricing applies annually and includes all modules, multi-depot support, API access, and chat support [1]. Discounts or custom terms must be handled by the Sales team rather than quoted directly to customers [1].

The Winter Shutdown runs from Thursday 24 December 2026 to Friday 1 January 2027 [1]. During this period, on-call coverage remains active with a small support rota that provides days in lieu for volunteers. The release train also pauses during these dates [2][4].

The annual learning budget for every eligible employee (excluding contractors) is **$1,500** [1][2]. This amount covers courses, books, certifications, conferences, and related travel or language classes. Unused funds do not carry over to the next year [1].

The three company priorities for 2027 are: [1] Enterprise expansion, [4] A credible path to profitability, and Priority 3 (which is not explicitly listed in the provided text). The leadership team agreed on these three priorities. Every team plan and OKR should trace back to at least one of them.
The required screen lock timeout is 5 minutes of inactivity [1]. Contractors must also ensure their device has a screen lock of 5 minutes or less [3].

We win about 41% of competitive deals against Routelytics [1]. The most common reason for losing these deals is price in the small-fleet segment. To counter this, we should compare total cost by highlighting fuel and overtime savings that typically exceed our subscription within two quarters [3].
A VP can sign contracts up to **$100,000** total contract value within their own budget [1]. This limit applies regardless of whether splitting is attempted to stay below the threshold.

A personal data breach that is likely to result in risk to individuals must be reported to the Portuguese CNPD **within 72 hours** of becoming aware [1]. This requirement applies under GDPR for all Fernhill Labs activities, as we are a processor and our lead supervisory authority is the CNPD [3]
Contractor timesheets must be submitted by the 3rd business day of each month [1].
The production release train runs every Tuesday and Thursday [1].
New API list endpoints must use **cursor pagination**. [1] Offset pagination is not allowed for these endpoints.
The on-call stipend for a primary week is $350 per week [1]. Secondary weeks are paid at half this rate, and engineers cannot be assigned to primary more than one week in five [1][2].

The incident lasted for **3 hours 12 minutes**, from 05:41 to 08:53 Lisbon time [1]. The solver success rate returned above 99.5% at 08:53, and the outage was fully resolved by 09:30 after monitoring confirmed stability [3].
The emergency credentials are stored at `secret/prod/breakglass-7731` in HashiCorp Vault [2].
API v1 will be switched off on 30 June 2027 [1][3]. This deprecation was announced in October 2026, and zero customers are expected to remain on the version after this date.

The salary band for a Senior Engineer (L4) in US-based locations (Austin and remote) ranges from $158,000 to $186,000 [1]. Portugal bands are maintained separately by People's team. Individual salaries within the band are confidential unless you ask your manager about your general position [4].
Our revenue for Q3 2026 was $14.82 million [1]. This represented a 6.6% quarter-on-quarter growth and a 38% year-over-year increase, with subscription revenue accounting for 94% of the total [1].

Our largest customer accounts for **18.6%** of ARR [1]. This figure is derived from Northgate Freight, which represents 31 depots across the UK and Netherlands [1]. The top 10 customers collectively represent 47% of ARR [1], with no single customer outside this group exceeding 2.5%.
Vendor payment runs happen every Tuesday and Friday [1].

Audit fieldwork for FY2026 takes place from **February 2 to February 13, 2027** [1]. The first week is conducted on-site in Lisbon, followed by a second week remotely. During this period, the team must hold daily stand-up meetings at 09:30 Lisbon time and submit all requests through Alice Chen using the shared folder rather than email attachments [2].

The draft 2027 budget for Engineering is $9.4 million [1]. This represents a +14% increase compared to the 2026 forecast, funding reliability and enterprise feature hires as well as the Head of Data role [1]. The figure includes salaries, benefits, contractors, tooling, and engineering travel costs [1].

The overall merit budget for the 2026 cycle was **3.8%** of total base payroll [1]. This figure included a separate promotion pool of 1.2% and was set slightly above peer group market movements due to elevated engineering attrition in late 2025 [1].

Requisition **HC-2027-114** is for a **Head of Data**. [1] This senior new hire will report to the VP Engineering and own the data platform, analytics behind Fleet Insights and Carbon Reporting, and internal BI. [1]

Calibration sessions for each department occur between 28 October and 6 November [1][2]. These sessions involve managers, the department head, and a People partner to ensure rating consistency across departments [1]. The specific dates are part of the annual performance review cycle that runs in October [2].

We use Checkr for background checks in the US [1][3]. The "Standard" package includes identity verification, criminal history for 7 years, and employment verification for the last two roles [1]. Finance and IT admin roles also receive a credit check where legally allowed [1].

Granite Bay Logistics is renewing at a **37% discount** off the Growth list price [1]. This exception was approved by Hana Sato and Kofi Mensah on 28 September in exchange for a 3-year prepaid term, a published case study, and adding the Carbon Reporting module for all depots.
The annual quota for a fully ramped Account Executive (AE) is **$720,000** in new Annual Contract Value (ACV). This represents 100% of the quarterly target, which equals $25 per quarter. [1]

The provided context does not state an absolute floor price specifically for the **Growth** tier. Passage [4] lists a public list price of $79 per seat per month, but it also states that any discounts or custom terms are handled by the Sales team and do not quote anything other than list prices to customers.

Passage [1] mentions an absolute floor price of $31 per seat per month, but this applies only to **Growth tier** deals for 3-year prepaid contracts above 500 seats; it does not apply generally or confirm a specific "absolute" floor that overrides the public list price in all scenarios.

The total open pipeline with a close date in Q4 2026 is **$6.2 million** in annual contract value across 58 opportunities [1]. This represents an average deal size of up to $107,000 ACV, driven by enterprise deals such as the $420,000 opportunity with Rheinland Kurier GmbH [4][1].

A fully paid-up, worldwide licence to the Veltrix patent portfolio covering all current and future RouteIQ products was settled for up to $2.35 million [1]. Any settlement exceeding this figure requires board approval [1]. Counsel will use an IPR filing as leverage at a much lower figure [1].

The Section 8 declaration for the US ROUTEIQ word mark is due by **20 July 2027** [1]. This deadline falls within the six-year window required to maintain registration under US law, with a grace period ending in January 2028 [2][3].

The codename for the proposed acquisition is **Project Kingfisher**, targeting **Quillstone Analytics** [1][2]. The deal involves acquiring this 28-person Utrecht-based company under that specific project designation.
The target pre-money valuation for the Series C round is $410 million [1].

Operation Driftwood will reduce **6 roles**, with the change becoming **effective on 15 January 2027** [1]. This includes eliminating 5 Austin Support Engineer positions and 1 Austin Support Team Lead role while retaining 2 senior US engineers remotely [2][4].

The Leadership Offside decided to raise the Growth tier price to $85 per seat per month starting March 2027 [1]. This increase applies only to new customers, while existing customers face a maximum renewal increase of 8% after their first renewal on or after 1 March 2027.

Your Statement of Work lists an hourly rate of $95 per hour [1]. This fee is billed monthly in arrears through Deel, with timesheets submitted by the 3rd business day of the following month [1][2]. Hours exceeding a weekly cap are not billable unless approved in writing before work begins [1][2].

Your relocation allowance is €12,400 [1]. This amount will be split into two payments: half in January 2027 and the other half in February 2027 [1]. You are responsible for any personal tax due on this income [1].
Your offer letter states that your **base salary** is $84,000 per year [1]. This amount is paid semi-monthly and constitutes 50% of your on-target earnings (OTE) for the role.

Access must be removed within **4 hours** of termination [1]. For involuntary terminations, it should happen immediately during the meeting [1]. IT also conducts quarterly access reviews where removals are completed within 2 working days [2], but this applies to existing employees rather than new terminations.
